QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 5 (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: The Speaking Hall seems to be ready, but Cole looks upset. What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: Cole needs you to borrow some Blue Ink from Stew, but there seems to be a quiz involved...
QuestInfo.2: Return to Cole with the ink.

0.0: Oh geez, I completely forgot that we needed Blue Ink for all these flags. We're going to have to borrow some from Stew.
0.1: Look, it's going to be incredibly embarrassing, but that's what you're for. Will you talk to the donkey for me?

yes.0: Excellent! While you're at it, make sure everybody thinks YOU ate the carrot cake in the lobby earlier. I'm extremely allergic to carrots, but he'll probably try to blame me.

no.0: I can't go over there myself! It's... unprofessional!

1.0: Did you tell everyone about the cake?

yes.0:
(You tell Cole everything that happened.)
Hmph. Allergies are nothing but mental weakness! But maybe I should send him a new cake to say sorry...
yes.1: Regardless, you did your duty for your country today! Hooray for you! Hooray for democracy!

stop.0: Maybe I can just mash up some blueberries...
